summary: The configuration-contract step needs changes. Legacy single-reviewer requests can select the wrong processing provider, and malformed layered input can escape validation with a KeyError.

outcomes.evidence: Independent review found concrete defects in settings resolution. The checkout was kept read-only.

checks: Focused unittest run covering test_settings_slots and five API settings tests: 11 passed.
A separate public-resolver reproduction ran three cases: two failed because processing remained Codex after selecting a sole Claude reviewer; one errored with KeyError for malformed layered slots.
Compared the legacy normalization behavior with the supplied baseline. The fixer's reported checks were treated as prior evidence, not as checks performed in this review.

case_results.evidence: The focused settings and API tests passed for defaults, presets, and model overrides; source tracing confirms provider effort overrides are applied through the same overlay.
The focused legacy-order test passed for a single reviewer and reversed mixed-provider input.
The duplicate-slot round-trip test passed for both providers with distinct slot selections.

The simple fresh-request test passed, but public-resolver reproductions with provisional default settings and with a saved legacy session retained Codex processing after an explicit change to a sole Claude reviewer without a processing override.
The legacy manifest and pending-load focused tests passed for recorded settings, historical defaults, request overrides, and manifest preservation.
The canonical saved and pending configuration test and duplicate-slot round-trip test passed.
The catalog-validation test passed for duplicate slots, independent processing, and unsupported selections.
A malformed reviewer slot supplied in defaults, combined with a provider model override, raised KeyError in overlay instead of the expected ApiError.

blocking: In lib/pr_review/settings.py, provisional or saved processing values are treated as explicit when a legacy request changes the sole reviewer. Preserve the implicit single-reviewer processing choice unless the request explicitly selects processing.

In lib/pr_review/settings.py, overlay indexes a slot's provider before validating its shape. Malformed layered reviewer slots must be rejected through the shared API validation path rather than raising KeyError.
